a_propos: La boîte à outils du montage : les cartes jouables de la style-library, classées par chaîne et par type d'effet. dans_ma_charte distingue ce que le créateur monte (sa charte 10-maison, les chaînes et cartes adoptées dans donnees/ma-charte.json) de ce qui n'est que de l'inspiration. L'inspiration à regarder (Pocinho, Prompt Motion, styles) est dans donnees/vitrine/index.json.

familles.description: Tout ce qui s'écrit à l'écran : titres, chiffres, listes, étiquettes, sous-titres, appels à l'action.
Ce que fait la caméra : zoom sur une zone, écran en 3D, transitions d'un plan à l'autre.
Deux choses dans le même cadre : comparaison, avant/après, split.
Ce qui se dessine ou habille : annotations, surlignages, mascottes, ambiances, particules.
Une interface qui s'exécute : UI rejouée, curseur, texte ou prompt qui se tape.
Une image, une vidéo ou une capture montrée dans un cadre, un médaillon, un mur.

effets.description: Un texte plein cadre ou dominant : titre de section, thèse, citation, mot choc, typo cinétique, logo et signature.
Un nombre qui compte, une courbe qui se trace, une barre qui pousse, un graphique, un prix, un score.
Plusieurs éléments structurés : étapes, sommaire, frise, grille, schéma de nœuds, diagramme.
Un petit texte posé à côté du sujet : label, lower third, pastille, pilule, badge, tag, cartouche.
La parole écrite : karaoké un mot, pilule, groupes de mots, sous-titres de dialogue.
Le passage d'un plan à l'autre : volet, balayage, flash, zoom traversant, inversion de fond, fondu.
Isoler une zone d'une capture réelle : zoom continu, spotlight, loupe, zone nette cerclée, dézoom révélateur.
Un écran, une fenêtre ou un mockup posé en perspective dans l'espace, poussé par la caméra.
Un geste dessiné sur le contenu : surligneur, cercle au feutre, flèche, soulignement, mot barré, trait qui se trace.
Une image, une vidéo ou une capture montrée dans un cadre : plein cadre, médaillon, mur, carrousel, mockup, photo détourée.
Une interface redessinée qui s'exécute : fenêtre d'appli, dashboard, chat, Finder, checklist, upload.
Un curseur qui clique, un prompt ou un terminal qui se tape, du code qui s'écrit.
Deux états face à face : split, volet avant/après, stack A/B, diff, échelle.
L'appel à l'action : mot-clé à commenter, barre de commentaire qui se tape, bouton, abonnement.
Un personnage qui joue l'action : mascotte pixel, robot, avatar, silhouette.
Ce qui habille le fond sans porter d'information : particules, halo, grain, grille de points, verre, 3D abstraite, liquide, glitch.

chaines.note: ma charte : crème quadrillé, jaune, Garet
chaines.resume: the workspace house style — derived from the Higgsfield creator-tutorial style (09), rebranded to the house yellow #FFD935. Yellow accent over three canvases (near-black navy, dark warm-amber dot-matrix, butter cream), frosted-glass panels

palette.notes: Jaune maison #FFD935 is the ONLY saturated color (brand accent — see memory jaune-maison-ffd935). Three takeover canvases exactly: navy, warm-amber olive, cream. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Garet Black ALL CAPS, tracking -0.05em, is the display voice; Garet regular for body. Instrument Serif italic is the second (editorial) voice. JetBrains Mono for pills, tags, eyebrow sublabels. Fonts in fonts/, wired in tokens.css (17/08).

chaines.charte_note: La charte elle-même : crème quadrillé, jaune, Garet.

chaines.pourquoi: 1136 cartes, la plus riche de la style-library
chaines.resume: Accent vert citron sur fonds marine, olive à points et crème, panneaux de verre en perspective à côté du speaker.

palette.notes: Lime #D6FD03 (sampled from refs) is the ONLY saturated color. Three takeover canvases exactly: navy, olive, cream. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight 800/900 ALL CAPS is the display voice. JetBrains Mono for pills, tags, eyebrow sublabels. Inter for rare supporting copy.

chaines.note: écrans en 3D, zoom sur zone, YouTube long
chaines.pourquoi: ton style YouTube long, mesuré sur ses vidéos
chaines.resume: Écrans posés en perspective dans une pièce, zoom continu vers une zone nommée, murs de prompts surlignés au marqueur.

palette.notes: Exactly three saturated colours: yellow (the accent), royal (the graphics stage), electric blue (the second marker). Two stages that never mix in one shot — royal for built graphics, charcoal for 3D screen work. Sampled per-pixel from the refs. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight ITALIC 800 caps is the signature — every pill leans forward. Instrument Serif is reserved for chapter titles and annotation labels, nothing else. Inter 24px carries prompt walls (small on purpose, it is a document). JetBrains Mono for badges and counters only.

chaines.pourquoi: format reel éprouvé, mesuré sur 10 reels
chaines.resume: Interfaces redessinées qui s'exécutent pendant qu'il parle sur scène crème, un seul accent orange, sous-titres en pilule.

palette.notes: ONE accent only (orange). Green and blue are UI statuses, not accents. The violet gradient exists only on the end-card. Ink is warm brown-black, never #000. Sampled per-pixel from the refs. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Display = heavy grotesque CAPS, tightly tracked (-0.035em), titles only; numbers inside titles are orange and count up. Poppins (geometric) carries everything else including the one-word captions — it is what makes the style read 'product'. JetBrains Mono for values, counters, paths, statuses only, never a sentence. No serif anywhere.

chaines.pourquoi: geste signature très efficace en reel
chaines.resume: Fonds blanc galerie ou noir, mots choc serif italique plein cadre, capture réelle floutée sauf une zone cerclée de néon.

palette.notes: White is HARD (#FCFCFC), never cream — warming it slides into Nathan Hodgson. Coral is the only permanent accent (mascot + script voice). Neons are a rotation system for annotation frames: ONE on screen at a time, color may change shot to shot. Sampled per-pixel from the refs. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: The clash between voice 1 and 2 IS the style. Voice 1: serif ITALIC CAPS (Playfair 700i) for shock words, 1-3 words max, stamped full frame. Voice 2: bold lowercase geometric (Poppins 700) for running captions, 2-4 words. Voice 3: coral/white italic script for connectives, overlapping the other voice (the outro signature). Mono appears only INSIDE real captures.

chaines.resume: Fond quasi noir avec halo bleu montant, cartes et pastilles en verre dépoli, cadres néon et texte en dégradé lumineux.

palette.notes: Dark cool canvas (#0A0E14 / deep #07121C), cream/white text, brand blue hero glow, yellow secondary pop, red/orange punctuation. One saturated glow per beat. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Plus Jakarta Sans (600-800) is the glow headline/number voice; Inter (400-600) is body/labels; Space Mono is data chips/timestamps/percentages. No serif.

palette.notes: 5 symbolic colors: warm paper, warm ink, brand blue (the eye-magnet), editorial red, cutout orange. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Fraunces (300 + 900 italic) is the statement voice; Archivo is metadata; Caveat is handwritten margin notes only.

chaines.pourquoi: la référence pour situer un lieu
chaines.resume: Cartes sur parchemin, une région surlignée en bleu par plan, étiquettes Oswald encadrées, grain de film et brûlures chaudes.

palette.notes: Two grounds: parchment/sage paper with warm ink, and projector-black film with cream text. brand blue highlights the one hero region/word; red is conflict punctuation only. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Oswald condensed caps is the cartographic voice (boxed labels, dates, headlines); Source Serif 4 is the narrative voice; Courier Prime is archival metadata.

chaines.pourquoi: énergie forte pour du contenu tech
chaines.resume: Fond noir, sous-titres crème à gros contour qui claquent mot à mot, panneaux de code colorés et cadres néon.

palette.notes: Captions are always cream with black stroke. brand blue is hero syntax + neon. Flame orange is the energy hit. Syntax pastels live only inside code panels and chips. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Luckiest Guy ALL CAPS with -webkit-text-stroke black rim (paint-order: stroke fill) is the caption voice. JetBrains Mono is all code/labels. Inter is rare supporting copy.

chaines.pourquoi: lisible et crédible pour des chiffres
chaines.resume: Fond noir, capitales blanches en boîtes, chiffres ambre façon terminal, hausses vertes et baisses rouges.

palette.notes: Flat fills only. Amber = numerals; blue = editorial accents (underline bars, chart keys); green/red = deltas exclusively. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Archivo 600-800 headlines; Archivo Narrow 600-700 UPPERCASE label boxes/kickers/axes; IBM Plex Mono for every numeral, ticker, delta, timestamp.

chaines.resume: Fond blanc cassé, grosse typo ronde Manrope, un moment de dégradé prismatique par carte, entrées qui rebondissent.

palette.notes: Light canvas always. Prism colors exist only inside the --prism gradient / wash / flare; solo accents are brand blue; sun yellow for tiny marks. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Manrope 700-800 sentence-case headlines and numbers; Inter supporting copy; Space Mono uppercase tape-deck tags in pill chips.

chaines.pourquoi: sobre et pro, idéal pour un lancement
chaines.resume: Scène noire, typo grotesque énorme blanche ou métallique, une seule source de lumière, beaucoup de vide.

palette.notes: Black + white carry 90% of the frame. brand blue is the single functional accent (one element per card). Copper/violet live only inside gradients and glows. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight 600-800 with -0.035em tracking is the SF Pro stand-in (headlines, numbers). Inter is quiet supporting copy. IBM Plex Mono is spec metadata only.

entrees.mecanique: The cumulative serif title (deconstructed from nick_saraev): a cream chapter card where the headline builds word by word in editorial serif italic, the <em> word landing in dark gold (jaune pur is unreadable on cream — house rule). Mono eyebrow on top. Opaque takeover, 9:16. The second typographic voice of the style: Instrument Serif italic. Slots: kicker (text), title (richtext, words revealed cumulatively, wrap the

Cream canvas quote card: charcoal serif-free quote reveals word by word, a jaune highlight pill sweeps behind the key phrase, attribution types on underneath in mono. Calm compared to the money card - one idea, lots of air. Slots: quote (use <em> around the highlighted phrase), attribution.

The olive dot-matrix "boot" card: title materializes from an LED-dot shimmer (blur + letter stagger) into solid white with a faint jaune glow; a mono pill sublabel types on underneath. Bokeh blobs drift very slowly behind. Slots: title, pill.

Quieter olive section marker (the stage-boot's little sibling): no mega title, just a jaune-outlined mono pill that draws its border, then the section name resolves inside it with the dot-matrix shimmer. For minor section changes where the full boot card is too loud. Slots: pill, title.

Full-screen chapter takeover. A clean centred glowing question headline — minimal, maximum impact. The entire card breathes with a strong central bloom. Kicker is a tiny italic label below the headline, almost a caption whisper. Slots: kicker (~16 chars), headline (~52 chars, <em> wraps one phrase for accent).

The navy step card: wide-tracked eyebrow ("STEP 1:") above one mega word ("SETUP"). Text enters at grey-pre and snaps to full white (the flip). Diagonal streaks + warm glow creeping into the bottom-right + vignette. Slots: kicker, title.

Multi-line thesis on the navy canvas. Kicker eyebrow, then the headline reveals word by word entering grey-pre; the whole line flips to white with the jaune emphasis span flipping last. Streaks + warm creep + vignette. Slots: kicker, headline (use <em> around the jaune emphasis word).

Social-proof view counters from reel DZU-J9roH-O: dark glass pills with an eye glyph and a view count, popping in staggered over the media zone (top ~58% of the vertical frame). Transparent — overlays any footage. Up to 6 badges; unused slots can be emptied (empty text hides visually). Slots: v1..v6 (text, e.g. "1,3 M").

Navy canvas, huge jaune number counting up with a label flipping in below. The number gets the kinetic dark rim so it punches. Streaks + warm creep. Slots: kicker, stat (final value, digits + optional prefix/suffix), label.

An exponential growth curve (SVG path draws from left to right, rising sharply). The glowing end value counts up as the line arrives at the right edge. Big number sits top-right at the apex. Different from sparkline: full-width canvas, the curve dominates, with subtle axis labels for scale context. Slots: kicker (~28 chars uppercase), stat (big value at curve end), label (~70 chars, <em> on one phrase), source (~40 c

A donut chart (SVG) with one accent segment that sweeps in. Center % counts up. The remainder is a dimmed ghost track. Aurora bloom, glass glow, breathing. Knob: data-pct on #t1-st-donut-svg (default 73). Slots: kicker (~28 chars uppercase), stat (e.g. "73%"), label (~70 chars, <em>), source (~40 chars).

A horizontal glowing fill bar in a glass track. The percentage label rides at the leading edge of the fill; the bar's scaleX animates from 0 to value. Aurora bloom, breathing glow. Knob: data-fill on .meter-track (0..1, default 0.73). Slots: kicker (~28 chars uppercase), stat (e.g. "73%"), label (~70 chars, <em>), source (~40 chars).

The cream kinetic-typography card: green-gradient mega number lands first, then a caps line reveals word by word with one mid-sentence word emphasized bigger, then a second smaller line tracks in while jaune confetti shards fly. Slots: stat, pre, emph, post, line2. (line1 = "pre EMPH post")
Left-to-right flow of 4 glass nodes joined by clean connector lines with small glowing chevron markers. Nodes spring on, connectors draw between them. Slots: title, n1, n2, n3, n4 (node labels).

Full-screen takeover. Title sits top-left; a thick rounded ink line draws itself left-to-right in gentle curves across the lower half of the frame. Three circle nodes pop in along the line as it draws, each with a mono label chip alternating above/below; the final node fills with the functional brand-blue accent to mark "you are here." Slots: title, n1, n2, n3.

Navy canvas full-screen version of the numbered-steps reveal: each row enters grey-pre with its number, then flips to jaune as the next row lands (the last row flips on its own beat). Rows sit slightly tilted like the in-room floats. Slots: kicker, s1, s2, s3.

Full-screen takeover. A friendly Manrope headline sits above three floating white cards popping in staggered left-to-right, each carrying a big faint numeral, a bold mini-headline and one line of Inter copy. The middle card carries THE prism moment: a thin gradient bar across its top edge that reveals once the row has landed. Slots: title, h1, b1, h2, b2, h3, b3.

Full-screen takeover. Two large glowing translucent circles overlap in the center of the canvas. Circles scale in from center (scale 0→1). Three labels: A (left circle), B (right circle), overlap (intersection). Clean SVG circles with glass fill and neon stroke. Slots: title, label_a, label_a_sub, label_overlap, label_overlap_sub, label_b, label_b_sub.

The beside-the-head numbered list: items pop in one at a time, each entering grey-pre and flipping to jaune when its successor lands. Perspective tilt + dark rim so it sits in the room. Right-side anchor, face-safe. Slots: i1, i2, i3 (leave i3 empty for a 2-item list).

The persistent top banner from reel Dba-jOyIbom: brand/topic line in jaune caps with an optional white subline, pinned to the top safe zone of the vertical frame. Transparent elsewhere. For collabs, announcements, or naming the tool being demoed. Slots: title, sub (optional).
The "IDEA -> $$$" move: top word lands, an arrow draws downward, the payoff word pops under it. Vertical stack beside the head, jaune with dark rim, slight tilt. Slots: top, bottom.

The frosted-glass step panel floating beside the speaker: eyebrow, title, and sub build line by line (each entering dim, flipping to jaune-soft), the panel snaps in tilted then drifts slowly while alive. Slots: kicker, title, sub.

A 3D-squircle icon chip pops in beside the speaker's head with a bounce, then bobs gently while alive. Holds an emoji (or Agent 3 swaps in a logo ). Optional second chip staggers in under it. Slots: icon1 (emoji text), icon2 (emoji text, optional).

The in-room jaune caps: 1-2 short lines floating beside the speaker's head (right side), perspective-tilted with a dark rim. Words reveal staged - line 1 enters white-grey, flips to jaune as line 2 arrives, line 2 flips right after. Whole block micro-drifts while alive. Slots: line1, line2 (leave line2 empty for a single-line float).

One short jaune caps phrase slamming into the lower-center frame (the "0 VALUE" / "NO MANUAL WORK" move): snaps in with a small overshoot, holds dead still, exits fast. The punchiest tier2 in the style. Slots: text.

Three small jaune mono tags spaced across the lower frame, appearing one at a time; the "active" tag is full jaune, previous ones dim to jaune-dim. Stays below y=930 so it never touches the face zone. Slots: tag1, tag2, tag3 (leave tag3 empty for two tags).
Dark den-tone lower-third: jaune dot pulses once, name types on in mono, role fades under it. Compact, bottom-left, face-safe. Slots: name, role.

One-word-at-a-time captions (the nathanhodgson / nick_saraev retention device): each word appears alone, big, centered above the PIP zone, timed on the voice. Words prefixed with "*" render in jaune (keywords). Transparent overlay for the whole reel duration. Slot convention: Agent 3 replaces the JSON in #skk-words with the real word timings from transcript.json → [{ "t": 0.00, "w": "ce" }, ...]. A word ending at "t"

Scene B irises open from a point (like clicking a UI element in the product — the graphics ARE the UI escaped into the room). A jaune ring leads the expanding edge and dissolves as the circle swallows the frame. Clip-path driven, fully seekable. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: B irises open from a click point behind a jaune ring that leads the edge and dissolves. Clip-path driven.

entrees.mecanique: The stage-boot card used as a section gate: an olive LED-dot shutter snaps over the frame (blur resolve, jaune glow pulse), the scene swaps behind it, the shutter dissolves off. This is the "chapter turn" between sections — heavier than a wipe, still fast (~1.4s covered). Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Olive LED-dot shutter resolves on with a jaune glow pulse, scene swaps behind, shutter dissolves. The chapter turn between sections.

entrees.mecanique: The 3-frame jaune-white pop (ref: v2's lightning-over-ingots beat). Flash spikes to full, the cut lands inside it, B settles from a 1.06 micro-punch. The fastest move in the kit — for rapid-fire montage runs where even a whip is too slow. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Three-frame jaune-white pop; the cut lands inside the flash, B settles from a 1.06 micro-punch. For rapid montage runs.

entrees.mecanique: A tilted frosted-glass pane whips across the frame left-to-right; the scene hard-swaps at the covered midpoint. The pane is the same glass as the tier2 panels (blur, jaune edge light), so the transition feels like a panel that grew wings. Smooth power3 whip, ~0.8s edge to edge. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Tilted frosted-glass pane whips across L-to-R, scene swaps at the covered midpoint. Same glass as tier2 panels, jaune leading edge.

entrees.mecanique: Cinematic blink: navy bars crush in from top and bottom, meet at center as a single jaune hairline flash, the scene swaps behind closed lids, and the frame reopens on B. The heaviest beat in the kit — use for the biggest narrative pivots, once or twice per video. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Cinematic blink: bars crush closed, meet as a jaune hairline flash, swap behind closed lids, reopen on B. Heaviest move; 1-2 uses per video.

entrees.mecanique: The match-cut bridge (ref: v3 cannon -> cannonball, v2 coin toss). A jaune prop tile flies across the frame in one smooth arc; the scene hard-swaps behind it at the exact moment the prop crosses center. The eye follows the object, the cut hides underneath it. Prop enters frame-right, exits frame-left, slight rotation + near-camera scale bump at center. Slots: glyph (prop face).
entrees.notes: The match-cut bridge: a jaune prop flies across frame, the scene hard-swaps under it at center crossing. Cut hidden by the moving object.

entrees.mecanique: The over-the-shoulder context swap (ref: v3 split-screen panels sliding over the speaker). A jaune-rimmed media panel slides in from frame-right (expo.out), drifts while alive, then slides back out. The base scene never cuts — the panel IS the b-roll. In assembly the panel body holds real footage; here it holds a placeholder. Slots: label.
entrees.notes: Jaune-rimmed media panel slides in from frame-right (expo.out), drifts while alive, slides back out. The base scene never cuts, the panel IS the b-roll.

entrees.mecanique: The speaker PIP grows to full-bleed and becomes the next scene — the inverse of zoom-through. Scene A dims and scales back behind it (depth), the jaune rim thins away as the PIP loses its "window" identity. Use when returning from a screen-share section back to the talking head. Slots: label.
entrees.notes: The speaker PIP grows to full-bleed and becomes the next scene; A dims and scales back behind. Inverse of zoom-through; use leaving screen-share sections.

entrees.mecanique: The talking-head punch-in (ref: v1/v2 jump cuts). Scale STEPS, never eases: 1.00 -> 1.07 -> 1.14, then a hard swap back to 1.00 on the next scene. This is the "no soft crossfades" rule as a cut — energy without motion blur. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Talking-head punch-in as jump cut: instant scale steps (1.00/1.07/1.14), then a hard cut back to rest. No easing, no blur.

entrees.mecanique: Scene B pushes A off frame-left, but at 60% of B's speed and under a darkening shade — the depth trick AE editors use so a push doesn't read flat. B overshoots 26px and settles. Jaune hairline rides B's leading edge. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: B pushes A off-left; A retreats at 60% speed under a darkening shade (depth), B overshoots 26px and settles. Jaune hairline on the leading edge.

entrees.mecanique: Rotational whip: the camera snaps -9deg with a scale punch and heavy blur, the cut lands at peak blur, and the next scene un-spins from +9deg back to level. The rotation direction carries through the cut (out CCW, in CCW), which is what sells it as one continuous camera move. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Rotational whip: -9deg + scale punch + blur out of A, cut at peak, B un-spins from +9deg to level. Rotation direction carries through the cut.

entrees.mecanique: A mega Inter Tight 900 word drives through the frame right-to-left as the wiper — kinetic type doing the transition's job. Slight skew while moving (motion lean), the scene hard-swaps as the word crosses center, and the word exits pulling the new scene's first beat behind it. Slots: word.
entrees.notes: A 420px Inter Tight 900 word drives through as the wiper with a motion lean; swap under its center pass.

entrees.mecanique: Four vertical slats of the next scene drop in staggered (70ms apart, expo.out) like AE mask reveals, jaune hairlines on the leading edges. Once the frame is covered the real scene B swaps in underneath and the slats dissolve — the seams never linger. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Four vertical slats of B drop in staggered 70ms apart (expo.out) with jaune leading edges; real B swaps under full cover, slats dissolve.

entrees.mecanique: The AE classic: camera whips left, both scenes travel as one world, motion blur ramps up mid-whip and clears on the settle. Scene B lands with a 30px overshoot then settles (the "hand-eased" AE finish). Swap is positional — B physically sits to the right of A. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Camera whips left as one world: both scenes travel together, blur peaks mid-move, B lands with a 30px overshoot settle.

entrees.mecanique: Crash-zoom out of scene A / crash-zoom into scene B. Scale punches to 1.55 with blur and a 1.5deg rotation kiss (dead-straight zooms read robotic), cut at peak, B lands from 1.4 and settles to 1. The AE "punch-in transition" with the rotation micro-detail pros add by hand. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Crash-zoom to 1.55 with blur and a 1.5deg rotation kiss, cut at peak, B settles from 1.4 to rest.

entrees.mecanique: The camera dives INTO a glass media panel until it becomes the next scene (ref: v1 UI zoom-pans, v3 panel grids). Panel scales up from its anchored spot to full-bleed (power3.inOut), scene A parallax-scales behind it, and the moment the panel fills the frame it IS scene B. The smoothest move in the kit — one continuous zoom, cut invisible at full cover. Slots: none.
entrees.notes: Camera dives into an anchored glass panel until it becomes the next scene; scene A parallax-falls behind. One continuous zoom, cut invisible at full cover.

entrees.mecanique: L'écran entier est à l'image, puis la caméra plonge sur UN rectangle — le champ dont on parle à cet instant. Un filet jaune encadre la zone, un label serif la nomme. Deux différences avec cx-ui-highlight, qui encercle sans bouger : · ici on entre physiquement dans la zone (transform sur un wrapper), · et l'écran vit en 3D dans une pièce, pas à plat sur un fond. La zone se décrit en % de l'écran via --rx / --ry / --rw
entrees.notes: La zone se decrit en --rx / --ry / --rw / --rh (% de l'ecran, largeur ET hauteur libres). Le filet se pose AVANT la plongee : on montre ou on va avant d'y aller. Complementaire de cx-ui-highlight, qui encercle sans bouger.

entrees.mecanique: Le geste d'annotation importé de Nick Saraev (13), porté au jaune le créateur : une VRAIE capture d'écran plein cadre, floutée et assombrie partout SAUF une zone nette encadrée d'un trait jaune #FFD935 épais. Pour pointer LE chiffre, LE bouton, LA ligne dont on parle — sans label, le cadre suffit. À réserver aux 1-2 moments par reel où il faut pointer précisément ; pour montrer un asset sans zone, prendre soc-media-s
entrees.notes: Le geste d'annotation importé de Nick Saraev, au jaune le créateur : vraie capture plein cadre, floutée/assombrie partout sauf UNE zone nette cerclée d'un trait jaune 8px qui dessine son périmètre, puis zoom continu vers la zone. Zone via --rx/--ry/--rw/--rh (%). Sans label. 1-2 par reel max — pour LE chiffre, LE bouton.

entrees.mecanique: Un écran (screencast, doc, UI) se tient dans une pièce en perspective et la caméra marche vers lui pendant tout le plan. Il part petit, loin et fuyant ; il finit grand, presque de face, débordant du cadre. Ce qui fait l'effet n'est pas le zoom, c'est le REDRESSEMENT : le lacet passe de --yaw-far à --yaw-near pendant l'approche, donc la perspective se déforme en continu. Un scale() plat ne produit rien de comparable —
entrees.notes: Le mouvement signature. C'est le redressement du lacet (--yaw-far -> --yaw-near) qui fait l'effet, pas le zoom : un scale() plat ne le reproduit pas. Ne jamais l'ease-out — le plan doit bouger encore à la coupe. Pousser --z-near vers 240px quand la carte n'a pas de chapitre.

entrees.mecanique: Une liste arrive ENTIÈRE et éteinte, puis chaque ligne s'allume au marqueur jaune au moment où on en parle. Le bloc ne bouge jamais : seul le marqueur avance. C'est ce qui permet de tenir 30 secondes sur un pavé de texte sans perdre le spectateur — il voit toujours où on en est. LA règle technique : le marqueur est un background-size animé de 0% à 100%, JAMAIS un fond qu'on insère ni un ::before qu'on déploie. Aucun
entrees.notes: Le marqueur est un background-size anime : aucun reflow, la liste ne bouge pas d'un pixel. Un seul item allume a la fois. Remplacer BEATS par les timecodes des mots du transcript ; le balayage part 0.14s AVANT le mot pour etre pose quand il tombe. La bascule de couleur est une tween, pas une classe (GSAP n'execute pas ses callbacks au seek).

A "Chapter X" accent pill slides in first; then a full-width dark glass bar slides up below the pill and reveals the section title. The bar has a thin accent top-edge line that draws across. Functional chapter/section marker for educational video. Slots: chapter (~12 chars, e.g. "Chapter 03"), title (~52 chars).

Name and role in a compact glass chip with a glowing accent dot indicator. Tighter and more interface-like than the pill — the dot gives it a "live" signal feel. Transparent background. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A wide frosted-glass cinematic letter-box strip spanning the full lower third. Name is left-anchored in large display type; role sits below in dimmer body type. The strip wipes in from the left edge and a hairline top/bottom edge animate-draw. Transparent overlay — only the strip paints over footage. Slots: name (~28 chars), role (~48 chars).

Attributed pull-quote lower-third. A large decorative open-quote glyph (accent colored, glowing) anchors the left; the quote text sits beside it in italic display type; an attribution line in dimmer body type follows below, preceded by an em-dash. Distinct mechanic: quote-mark-first reveal, text types in via clip-path, attribution fades up after. Slots: quote (~90 chars), attribution (~40 chars).

Name card with a live-style timestamp chip in Space Mono. The chip sits above-right, showing hours:minutes:seconds frozen at a plausible time (no Date.now() — deterministic). A colon-blink within the timestamp gives the "live broadcast" tick (finite repeat). The name card is frosted glass. Slots: name (~26 chars), timestamp (~11 chars, e.g. "09:41:22 UTC").

A data/metadata readout bar in monospace — two or three metadata fields in Space Mono separated by glow-rule dividers, with the name above in display type. Reads like a terminal HUD or broadcast ticker overlay. Anchored lower-left. Transparent overlay. Slots: name (~26 chars), meta (two metadata strings, ~30 chars each, shown as "FIELD · VALUE" pairs in the mono bar).
L-shaped corner glass card hugging the lower-left corner, name/role inside, accent corner-glow. Transparent background — only the card paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Four L-shaped neon corner brackets that draw around a name block. The brackets animate-draw inward from the outer corners toward the center. The name block starts invisible inside the bracket cage and snaps into focus as the last corner closes. Sits over live footage — only the brackets and text paint. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Name card with a glowing metric row beneath — a small label + a number that counts up. Knob: data-target on the counting element (default 128000). The counter is Space Mono, accent-colored, and reaches its value with a power2.out ease. Transparent overlay over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), count (numeric target via data-target="128000").

Name and role flanking a glowing vertical divider line that draws down from top. Left side holds the bold name; right of the divider holds the dimmer role. Anchored lower-left. Transparent overlay. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A glowing leader line draws from a fixed anchor node (left edge) to a small neon marker dot, then a name+role block fades in beside it. The connector is the visual hero — a dashed SVG path that animates-draws left-to-right. Sits over live footage; only the component paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Two stacked glass cards: a compact name card on top (slightly wider, brighter accent rim), and a larger topic/subject card below with a dimmer accent and a small glow-dot kicker. The two cards animate in with a stagger — top card springs, bottom follows with a beat delay. Sits over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), topic (~60 chars).

Two-person interview lower-third: two stacked glass name/role blocks. Both cards spring in staggered from lower-left; each row glows its own subtle accent rim. Sits over live speaker footage — fully transparent background, only the cards paint. Slots: name, role, name2, role2.

A vertical neon blue edge bar glows to the left of name and role on a subtle dark glass strip. The bar draws in from bottom to top; the text slides in from the right. Transparent background — only the strip paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A glass card flips in on its Y-axis (rotateY 90→0) to reveal name + role. The front face is the dark glass card with text; the back is an accent-tinted opaque face that's visible for a split-second during the flip. perspective + preserve-3d container makes the 3D flip legible over footage. Unique mechanic in this set: only card using 3D CSS transform driven by GSAP. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

An animated GPS drop-pin icon falls from above and sticks with a spring bounce; a frosted pill below it reveals the place name and coordinate line. The pin glows blue. Distinct from other lower-thirds: vertical entry axis, icon-first storytelling, mono coords. Slots: place (~28 chars), coords (~22 chars, e.g. "37.7749° N, 122.4194° W").

Frosted glass name card anchored lower-left. A thin accent glow rim traces the card edge; name and role glide in after the card springs on-screen. Sits over live speaker footage — fully transparent background, only the card paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

The name is rendered as gradient clip-text (white→accent blue), glowing on a dark glass backing. Role appears smaller and dim beneath. The gradient text is the hero; the card is restrained around it. Transparent background — only the card paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A gradient-glow horizontal bar (accent → transparent) as the backing, with name/role text floating over it. No hard card box — the bar IS the surface. A thin accent edge line runs across the top of the bar. Sits over live speaker footage — fully transparent background. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A social @handle bar anchored lower-left. A platform glyph (SVG icon, accent colored) leads the row; the @handle text types in character-by-character using a Space Mono clip-width reveal, giving a terminal typewriter feel over a minimal glass pill. Dark, narrow, clean — deliberately different from the wider glass cards. Slots: handle (~28 chars, include @), platform (~8 chars, e.g. "LinkedIn").

Name and role rendered as two separate glowing pill chips stacked vertically. Each chip has its own accent color: name chip is white-glow / blue border, role chip is a softer blue-tinted glass. They stagger in independently. Transparent overlay over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A horizontal lens-flare streak sweeps across once left-to-right, then the name resolves sharp on a faint glass underlay behind it. Role fades up below. The flare streak is a wide gradient bar with a bright hot core and soft wings. Transparent overlay over live speaker footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A pulsing "LIVE" indicator dot + label pill on the top-left of the card, then the name and role below. The dot rings outward in a finite sonar pulse during the hold. Distinct "broadcast" energy — not just a name card. Anchored lower-left. Transparent overlay. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Name/role glass card with a location line beneath it. A clean glowing pin marker (teardrop SVG path) precedes the location text. The marker draws on via a stroke animation, then fills with accent glow. Sits over live speaker footage — fully transparent background. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars), location (~30 chars).

Name/role glass card with a small LOGO placeholder lockup to the left: a glowing rounded-square mark with an accent gradient fill. The logo and the text share one glass surface; a thin accent divider separates them. Sits over live speaker footage — fully transparent background. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Podcast-vibe name card. A glowing microphone icon (SVG) lives on the left inside a small neon-rimmed circle; name + role float beside it on a frosted pill. The mic icon pulses with a neon bloom. Clean, broadcast-studio feeling. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A compact minimal mini-card: tiny glass chip, name bold + role micro beneath, one accent dot. Designed to be unobtrusive — small footprint, maximum legibility, instant read. Perfect for returning guest IDs or secondary speaker credits. Sits over live speaker footage — fully transparent background. Slots: name (~20 chars), role (~32 chars).

Glowing name text on a slim dark glass underlay + a glowing accent underline that draws in. Role appears smaller beneath. Deliberately spare — accent is entirely in the glow and the underline. Transparent background — only the underlay paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

An extruded 3D glass nameplate rendered with CSS perspective tilt — the card leans back in space, revealing a thick glowing side-depth edge. The name sits on the face; role on a dimmer sub-ledge. Sits over live speaker footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).
Name/role inside a NEON-OUTLINED rounded frame (the outline draws/illuminates), on faint dark glass. Anchored lower-left. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A long neon-rimmed pill nameplate — wide, low, horizontal — that stretches across the lower-left. Name (bold, large) on the left side of the pill; role (lighter, mono) on the right. A bright vertical divider separates them. The pill outline illuminates from both ends and meets in the center. Sits over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A "now playing" media bar lower-left. A pulsing music-note glyph marks the left; title and artist stack above a thin progress-line that grows from 0 to ~70%. Frosted glass pill with an animated progress track — the feel of a Spotify mini- player overlaid on a dark canvas. Slots: title (~36 chars), subtitle (~36 chars).

A small glowing avatar dot anchored lower-left with an orbiting ring satellite that travels a finite arc (270 degrees), then a name card slides out to its right. The orbit uses a rotating wrapper div so no trig/JS is needed for the arc path. Transparent overlay over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Name and role sit inside a wide rounded glass pill with a glowing edge. The pill springs in from below with a slight bounce; name and role stagger up inside it. Transparent background — only the pill paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

An edge-lit rounded portrait frame placeholder (left, neon rim) with an empty glowing frame interior + a name card beside it. The frame rim draws/illuminates; the name card springs in from the right of the frame. Sits over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A name card with a thin talk-progress bar running beneath it. The bar fills left-to-right over the card's hold duration (simulating how long the speaker has been talking). The bar track is a hairline dark glass line; the fill is an accent glow gradient. Sits over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Name/role glass card with a short attributed quote line beneath. A large glowing quotation mark anchors the left of the quote row. Sits over live speaker footage — fully transparent background. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars), quote (~80 chars).

A glass name/role block with a row of 5 glowing star chips that pop in staggered beneath the name. Stars are accent-blue neon outline stars that fill glow on entry. Anchored lower-left. Transparent overlay. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

An angled glowing ribbon nameplate anchored lower-left. The ribbon is a parallelogram shape with an accent neon edge — name sits large on the ribbon, role on a smaller secondary band below it, both bands angled ~-3°. A neon rim traces the top edge of the primary band. Entirely different layout mechanic from all the rectangular / pill lower-thirds. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A name card flanked by one big glowing L-bracket on its left that draws itself on — two strokes tracing top+left edges. The bracket glows blue; name and role sit inside the implied frame. Transparent overlay over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A glass tab nameplate that slides out from the left edge of frame. The tab has a visible left-edge "spine" (a 4px accent stripe) and the right side is a slightly rounded glass surface. Name and role live inside; the entire assembly enters from x: -full-width so it feels like it's being pulled out of the left wall of the screen. Mechanically unique: the entrance is a horizontal slide-reveal, not a fade-in. Slots: name

Name + Space-Mono @handle + a small glowing platform dot, on frosted glass. Anchored lower-left. Transparent background — only the card paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars — used as @handle here).

A soft localized pool of light blooms lower-left — like a theatre spotlight on the speaker corner — and the name + role fade up within it, sitting on a minimal transparent glass plate. No hard card edge; the glow IS the container. Transparent overlay over live footage. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).
Name stacked OVER role with a glowing accent dividing rule that draws in between them. On frosted dark glass, anchored lower-left. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A name card with an inline glowing stat chip at the right end. The chip shows a metric in mono type inside a bright neon-rimmed capsule, separated from the name by a thin accent rule. The chip number counts up from zero to the target. Sits over live footage — only the component paints. Slots: name (~26 chars), stat (~8 chars, e.g. "4.9M", "87%", "$2.4B").

A compact name line above a horizontal row of small glowing topic-tag chips that pop in staggered left-to-right. Each chip is an accent-bordered glass pill. Different from ratingname (no stars, free-text tags, horizontal scan). Anchored lower-left. Transparent overlay. Slots: name (~26 chars), tags (comma-separated topic chips, ≤6 tags).

A minimal full-width thin strip pinned to the very bottom of the frame. Name left-aligned, role right-aligned, separated by a stretching accent glow rule along the top edge. Maximally minimal — no glass card box, just the strip. Anchored bottom edge (full-width). Transparent overlay. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

A scrolling news-ticker bar anchored to the bottom edge. A category flag pill sits left with a glowing accent color; headline text scrolls rightward across a frosted dark glass strip. Finite scroll — the text completes one pass then holds. Slots: tag (~14 chars), headline (~90 chars).
Slim wide horizontal glass bar (anchored lower edge), name left, role right, accent edge-light on left border. Bar wipes in from left. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

Glass card with an avatar-circle placeholder, a small chip above the card (e.g. "Trust accrued"), name, and role/quote. A short dashed connector line trails toward the speaker (right side). All anchored lower-left. Transparent background — only the card + chip + line paint. Slots: tag (~20 chars), name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

The name types in character-by-character in Space Mono with a blinking cursor (cursor blink is FINITE: repeat 6, yoyo). After the name is fully typed, the role line fades in beneath. All on a minimal dark glass strip anchored lower-left. Slots: name (~24 chars), role (~40 chars).

Minimal nameplate: name displayed large, bare (no card box), and a glowing underline that grows from left beneath the name as it appears, then role fades in below that line as a dimmer label. The underline is the mechanical hero — a laser-drawn neon stroke with a glow tail. Deliberately airy; no glass box, no background fill. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).

An audio-waveform strip lower-left. 20 vertical bars of varying hardcoded heights animate up and down in a staggered finite pattern, suggesting a live EQ/spectrum. Name and role sit to the right of the waveform in a compact text block — no glass card surround, the waveform IS the visual anchor. A thin neon accent line underlines the whole unit. Slots: name (~26 chars), role (~40 chars).
Title framed by big editorial brackets, centered, with a yellow underline sweep. Slots: kicker, headline (<em> emphasis), source.
Yellow circle eye-magnet behind a thin+black-italic Fraunces headline, archive cutout scrap. Slots: kicker, headline (<em> for italic-black emphasis), scrap (image), source.

Documentary evidence-board: taped paper title card, red stamps that slam in, red string + pushpins, a magnifier. Kraft paper. Slots: title, stamp (e.g. CLASSIFIED), note (handwritten sticky), filed (small meta).

Title surrounded by scattered floating cutouts, circles, scribbles on crumpled paper. The busy hero collage. Pieces pop in choppily from all directions. Slots: kicker, line1, line2 (marker word), wordmark, scrap1/2/3 (images).

Editorial "edit mark": one word struck through in red with a handwritten correction above it, a hand-drawn arrow to a yellow Vox wordmark circle. Slots: pre, struck (crossed word), post, correction (handwritten), wordmark.

Title inside a vintage TV: power-on, chromatic aberration, scanlines, barrel vignette. A deliberately darker register (a screen), keeps the yellow accent. Slots: channel (small top label), title, label (glowing box), wordmark.

Big title left, masked halftone portrait right (yellow sticker outline), a red dashed arrow connecting a Vox circle to the subject, scattered scraps. Slots: kicker, headline (<em> emphasis), subject (image), wordmark.
Title over a full-bleed halftone photo with a bottom scrim. Photo takeover. Slots: kicker, headline (<em> for marker emphasis), photo (image), source.
Plain ink title; a yellow highlighter marker sweeps across the key phrase (the hero move). Minimal paper + grid. Slots: kicker, pre, key (highlighted phrase), post, source.
Library catalog card: ruled lines, a red index tab, a typed label and code, the title in serif on the ruled lines. Clean archival. Slots: tab (label), code, title, sub.

Title over a vintage map fragment (lat/long grid + static engraved routes), a yellow location marker with a crosshair. Geography register. Slots: kicker, headline (<em> emphasis), place (marker label).
Title words on stacked yellow highlighter marker boxes, skewed and hand-pasted. Slots: kicker, line1, line2, line3 (line3 optional).
Giant ghost chapter number (outline) fills the frame; title overlaid. Slots: number, kicker, headline (<em> emphasis).
Vertical split: title on paper left, halftone image panel right, ink rule between. Slots: kicker, headline (<em> emphasis), panel (image), source.

Giant multi-line serif title filling the frame, mixed weights per line, one keyword sitting over a yellow circle. Type-dominant, minimal. Slots: line1, line2, line3, keyword (sits in the circle), source.
The title itself as a big distressed red rubber stamp that slams in. Paper. Slots: title, date (sub-stamp), kicker.

Broadcast layout: title upper on paper, a yellow lower-band ticker with a red BREAKING tag. Band slides up, ticker text scrolls a finite amount. Slots: tag, headline (<em> emphasis), ticker (band text), kicker.
Title on a torn newspaper strip laid diagonally over faint newsprint columns. Slots: kicker, headline (<em> marker emphasis), source.

A big central number with 2–3 qualifier labels arranged around it, each connected by a short STATIC tick/leader line (thin, no arrowheads). Like a labeled diagram of the figure. Lines draw in via scaleX/scaleY; labels fade. Slots: kicker, stat, note1, note2, note3, source.

A radial gauge: a faint ink track ring with a yellow arc that sweeps clockwise to the value via SVG stroke-dashoffset. The number sits in the center. Functional arc, not an arrow. Slots: kicker, stat (center number), label (richtext), source. Knob: data-pct on the svg (0..100, default 73).

Proportional horizontal bar. A kraft track spans the canvas; a yellow fill wipes to the value (data-fill = 0..1). The number rides at the head of the fill. Functional data-viz as the eye-magnet — no circle. Slots: kicker, stat (label on the fill, e.g. 73%), label (richtext), source. Knob: data-fill on .track sets the fill fraction (default 0.73).

The stat centered inside GIANT editorial square brackets [ 73% ]. The two bracket characters are rendered as separate absolutely-positioned elements that slide in from off-screen (left bracket from left, right bracket from right). A thin yellow rule sits under the number. Number clip-reveals after brackets land. Distinct from callout: no rules above/below number — brackets ARE the frame. Slots: kicker, stat, label (r

A tear-off desk calendar: RED header band (month/label), two binding rings at the top, big number as the day/figure on the white page below. Frames time-based stats. Page drops/flips in via a perspective scale + y translate. Slots: kicker (month band text), stat (the number), label (richtext <em>), source.

The number set like a magazine pull-quote: centered between two heavy rules that draw outward, an oversized leading symbol, and an italic Fraunces caption. Restrained — type and rules only, one yellow underline on the unit. No circle. Slots: kicker, stat, unit (small trailing unit), label (richtext, <em>), source.
Opaque paper. The yellow circle is the eye-magnet; the number sits on it. Slots: kicker, stat (the number, e.g. "73%"), label (what it means), source.

One LARGE yellow circle vs a SMALL reference circle (area comparison). The large circle's area is proportional to the stat; small circle is reference unit. The big multiplier number is the hero. Circles pop in via scale. Slots: kicker, bigLabel, smallLabel, stat (the multiplier), label (richtext), source. Knob: data-mult on #pack-wrap (integer, default 12) — sets the area ratio.

5 columns grow from a baseline. Tallest column is yellow (hero); the rest kraft. x-axis labels sit under each column; the hero VALUE is big above the tall column. Columns scaleY from transform-origin bottom, staggered steps. Slots: kicker, c1..c5 (axis labels), stat (hero value), label (richtext), source.

The number anchored HUGE in the top-right, rotated ~-8deg, bleeding off the top + right edges. Label + source anchored bottom-left for a strong diagonal negative-space composition. One yellow slab accent. Number clip-reveals diagonally. Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext <em>), source.

A 10x10 grid of 100 dots; the first N pop in yellow, the rest stay as faint ink outlines. "N in 100" made literal. Functional viz as eye-magnet — no circle. Slots: kicker, stat (the big number beside the grid), label (richtext), source. Knob: data-fill on .dots sets how many dots fill yellow (0..100, default 73).

Big number in front of a masked vintage engraving: a duotone/halftone block (orange + ink) fills most of the canvas as the image placeholder, with a slow camera push for depth. One yellow marker word in the label. Vox archive feel. Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext, <em> = yellow marker), engraving (image), source.

Giant centered Fraunces number with a small yellow superscript dagger (†). At the very bottom, an academic footnote: a thin rule then fine-print Archivo caveat text. Number clip-reveals from center; footnote fades up last. Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext, what the number means), footnote (fine-print caveat), source.

A ratio set as an editorial fraction: big ink numerator over a ghosted, outline denominator, divided by a heavy rule. Reads as "N of every D". Slots: kicker, num (numerator), den (denominator), label (richtext), source.

Huge numeral flush-left, bleeding off the bottom-left edge. Label stacked in a right column. No circle — the scale of the number IS the eye-magnet; one yellow slab under the unit anchors the accent. Slots: kicker, stat (the number), unit (small trailing unit, e.g. %), label (richtext, <em> emphasis), source.

A row of 7 graded intensity cells from pale paper → yellow → red (severity scale). The hero cell is called out by a thick outline + elevated label; big hero value. Cells built in JS deterministically, color interpolated from token-like RGB stops. data-level (1..7, default 5) marks the hero. Slots: kicker, stat, lowLabel, highLabel, label (richtext), source. Knob: data-level on .heat-row (1..7, default 5).

A single row of 10 identical person silhouettes (circle head + rounded- trapezoid body via SVG path), N filled yellow, the rest faint ink outline. Reads "N in 10". Big number displayed beside/above. Built in JS deterministically. Distinct from dot-grid: figurative icons, single row of 10 (not a grid of 100). Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext <em>), source. Knob: data-fill on .figures (0..10, default 7).

An accounting ledger: ruled rows on kraft paper, a column of line items, and one HERO row whose value cell wipes yellow. The stat is the bottom-line total. Slots: kicker (ledger title), row1l/row1v, row2l/row2v (faint context rows), heroLabel, stat (hero value), source.

A horizontal meter with MIN and MAX labels at the ends + tick marks along it, and a notch/marker block sitting at the value position with the big number in a callout above the notch; the filled portion up to the notch is yellow. Distinct from the plain bar: labeled scale + positioned notch + callout. Slots: kicker, stat, minLabel, maxLabel, label (richtext <em>), source. Knob: data-pct on .track (0..100, default 73)

A magnifier prop hovers over the number: a circular LENS (functional — OK per contract) with a handle, the number INSIDE the lens rendered larger/sharper than a faint smaller "background" version behind it. The lens drifts in and settles over the figure. Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext <em>), source.

The number over a faint topographic/contour or grid MAP (build the map look with layered repeating gradients / concentric rounded shapes — deterministic), a single yellow DIAMOND location marker (functional map marker, not a pin) with a place label; the stat ties to the place. Slow push for depth. Slots: kicker, stat, place, label (richtext), source.

A huge "N×" lockup where the "×" is set in yellow to separate the magnitude from the unit. A small "1×" baseline reference is set below-right in a paper-2 chip, communicating "N times more than this". Caption label below the number. Big number pops in with back.out; baseline reference fades in after. Slots: kicker, stat (the multiplier, e.g. 12), baselineLabel (e.g. "vs editing by hand"), label (richtext), source.

The number rendered as mechanical split-flap digit cells (dark cells, paper glyphs, a center seam). A stepped clip-wipe gives the count-up / flip feel. Slots: kicker, stat (the number string), label (richtext), source.

Number huge over a full-bleed halftone archive photo, with an ink scrim so the type reads. The photo slowly pushes (ken-burns). One yellow marker word in the label. No circle. Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext, <em> = yellow marker), photo (image), source.

A filled pie via conic-gradient (yellow slice = value, rest kraft/ink). One yellow wedge is pulled slightly out (offset a few px from center). The big % number sits beside the pie. Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext), source. Knob: data-pct on #pie-wrap (0..100, default 73). JS sets the conic angle.

A perforated postage stamp: notch-dot perforated edge via repeating radial-gradient, halftone engraving fill behind the number, big denomination center, and a DIAGONAL-BARS cancellation postmark (NOT a circle — bands of parallel diagonal lines crossing the stamp). Stamp pops in with a scale snap. Slots: kicker, stat, country (small label), label (richtext), source.

An angled price tag (rounded rect with a punched hole circle + a clean straight string line to top corner). Big number as the price. Tag swings in from a top-pivot via back.out. No scribbles — string is a static SVG line. Slots: kicker, stat, unit, label (richtext <em>), source.

A segmented bar of 10 rectangular BLOCKS with visible gaps between them; N blocks filled yellow (rest kraft outline). Fills light up left→right stepped. Big "N/10" value displayed prominently. Built in JS deterministically. Distinct from the smooth bar (gaps + rectangles) and dot-grid (square blocks, not circles). Slots: kicker, stat, label (richtext <em>), source. Knob: data-fill on .segments (0..10, default 7).

An oversized opening quotation mark (yellow, Fraunces, top-left) anchors the card. The stat reads as the pulled figure of a pull-quote — large, italic — with a supporting richtext line below and an attribution kicker under a short rule. Quote mark pops in with back.out overshoot; figure clip-reveals left-to-right. Slots: kicker (attribution), stat, label (richtext, the quote line), source.

A prize-ribbon ranking treatment: big ordinal number drops in, then a notched yellow banner/sash unfurls beneath it carrying a label. The banner uses a clip-path with forked ends — like a 1st-place prize ribbon. No arrows. Slots: kicker, stat (e.g. "#1" or "1st"), bannerLabel, label (richtext <em>), source.

A narrow thermal receipt slip centered on the canvas. Zigzag torn top + bottom edges via clip-path. Monospace Archivo. Faux line-items, then a thick rule and a hero TOTAL line at the bottom. Receipt "prints" via a clip-reveal top→bottom. Slots: kicker (store/title), item1l/item1v, item2l/item2v, stat (total), label, source.

A 180° arc along the top half: faint ink track + yellow fill sweeping via stroke-dashoffset. Big number centered below the arc. Min + max labels at ends. Distinct from full arc-gauge (t1-stat-arc) — this is a HALF circle. Slots: kicker, stat, minLabel, maxLabel, label (richtext), source. Knob: data-pct on <svg> (0..100, default 73). Arc computed in JS.

The number SHARP in a focused spotlight pool (radial light on a dark ink-ish paper), heavy darkened edges (strong vignette).
